rationale: Anchored after the BLS technique block to test recall of adult CPR compression-to-ventilation ratio — a classic high-stakes numerical fact where wrong recall (2:1, 15:2) is dangerous.

Anchored after the ALS algorithm block to reinforce understanding of shockable versus non-shockable rhythms — a critical decision point where misclassification leads to harmful defibrillation or withheld shocks.

Anchored after the post-resuscitation care block to test application of ROSC management priorities — a frequent exam trap where candidates confuse temperature targets or miss the normoglycaemia requirement.
